lead.title: TILT Biotherapeutics: 44% objective response with intravenous oncolytic virus TILT-123 in resistant ovarian cancer
lead.deck: Phase Ib PROTA presented at ESMO 2026: 4 confirmed partial responses in 9 evaluable patients (2 later complete), 78% disease control, no dose-limiting toxicity, combined with Keytruda and liposomal doxorubicin. Proof of concept for an intravenously delivered oncolytic virus.

milestone.title: FDA approves Xbrane's Lucamzi, a Lucentis biosimilar
milestone.summary: Lucamzi (ranibizumab-blrz) is approved in the US for wet AMD and other serious eye diseases; Xbrane is preparing a 2027 US launch with unnamed partners.
milestone.why: First marketable US product for a small Swedish biotech in biosimilars: a de-risking milestone toward revenue.

brefsEurope.title: Vicore's ASPIRE IPF trial passes futility analysis
brefsEurope.summary: The independent committee recommends continuing the phase 2b of buloxibutid unchanged (analysis on ~100 patients); topline mid-2027, cash runway into H2 2028.

brefsEurope.title: Genmab: petosemtamab halves death risk in head and neck cancer in phase 3
brefsEurope.summary: LiGeR-HN1, first-line with pembrolizumab: death HR 0.50 (p<0.0001), both primary endpoints met. A major comparable for EGFR/LGR5 bispecifics.

brefsEurope.title: ResoTher Pharma heads for Sweden's Spotlight via reverse takeover, ~SEK 333M valuation
brefsEurope.summary: Listing planned December 2026; ~SEK 80M available (48M raised in 2026 + 32M convertible loan) for RTP-026 after heart attack, phase IIb (>200 patients) targeted early 2027.

brefsEurope.title: DEBRA Research invests in Topadur for dystrophic epidermolysis bullosa
brefsEurope.summary: Amount undisclosed; preclinical program with the University of Freiburg and the EB Research Institute in Salzburg. TOP-N53 is in phase 2a for systemic-sclerosis digital ulcers.

brefsEurope.title: Elicera co-founder awarded SEK 4M for longer-lived CAR-T cells
brefsEurope.summary: Four-year Uppsala project on tonic signaling so CAR-T cells survive and reach solid tumors, including glioblastoma models.

word.definition: A virus engineered to selectively infect and kill tumor cells while waking up the immune system.

how.t: The virus is injected into the tumor or, like TILT-123, intravenously.
It replicates inside tumor cells and bursts them.
Tumor debris and expressed cytokines recruit T cells.

word.why: VC angle: systemic delivery and combinations with checkpoint inhibitors revive a modality long confined to intratumoral injection.
